verdict.rationale: x402 includes a hosted CDP Facilitator that processes transaction data, so a data-use or AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about AI-training data policies, opt-outs, or data-use controls. It covers only payments, settlement, screening, discovery and governance.
